verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.orama.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the docs, including Cloud and MCP Server pages. A companion llms-full.txt also serves full doc content, covering data sources, projects and collections. So an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: no first-party page explaining or promoting llms.txt usage for agents, no independent/community corroboration of agent workflows using it, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
